quest.title: Three Poignant Perfumes
quest.description: Zhongli isn't concerned with the deicide itself, but with upholding Liyue's sacred traditions by giving a proper farewell to an archaic lord. Having selected a suitable batch of Noctilucous Jade, your next task is to prepare some perfumes as an offering to the Geo Archon.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x525, Mora x19125, Adventurer's Experience x7, Mystic Enhancement Ore x4

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey boss. Do you sell Silk Flowers here?

dialogues.speaker: Bolai
dialogues.text: Silk Flowers? We certainly do! Which kind would you like?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Which kind...? The, uh... the good kind. The best kind. ...Remind Paimon what kinds there are again?

dialogues.speaker: Bolai
dialogues.text: Ugh. You ignorant shoppers, always coming in here with your stupid questions...

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Golden House Maiden, Valley Weaver, and Fate's Yearning. One of each to start with, if you don't mind.

dialogues.speaker: Bolai
dialogues.text: ...My goodness! This gentleman is quite the connoisseur!

dialogues.speaker: Bolai
dialogues.text: You two must be his servants. Please refrain from any further attempts to contribute.

choices.text: Well, guess I had it coming...

response.speaker: Bolai
response.text: Now then... Please peruse at your leisure. Do let me know if you have any further thoughts.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Silk Flowers exhibit different properties based on how their environmental conditions differ from their ancestral habitat... Nevertheless, these are fine specimens. Excellently preserved.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Just look at the abundant foliage here. And these stamens, glamorous as a maiden of the Golden House. This strain is an evergreen, and mostly grows under complex hydrological conditions.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: By contrast, this variety thrives in any dark, damp location, often in large clusters. Morphologically, it is distinguished by the profusion of petals and densely packed stamens, though its powerful scent gives it away just as easily.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Lastly, this strain is quite the recluse. Unlike its exuberant cousins, flowers and foliage are minimal, and when in season, it has a subtle yet enduring scent. It was first discovered by the ancients when they scaled the mountains in search of the adepti.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Silk Flowers have all but disappeared from the wild today, due to geographical changes over Liyue's history. Most are now grown by horticulturalists.

response.speaker: Bolai
response.text: Wow. A true connoisseur. Most of that was news even to me!

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: I possess but a smattering of trivial knowledge. My traveler friend is the one to watch — they are on track to set foot in every corner of the world.

choices.text: What's so impressive about that...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Mr. Zhongli, you're way too humble... So which Silk Flower did you want, anyway?

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: I'll take them all, boss.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Again!?

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: How can I put this... When purchasing opera tickets, it is natural to decide based on which singer has the most melodious voice. The same logic applies when purchasing a pet bird.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: But this Silk Flower purchase is not an analogous case. The same logic does not apply.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Perhaps you don't know. Tradition states that we should decoct perfume from different sub-species of Silk Flower when making an offering to a Statue of The Seven. Rex Lapis will then make his own choice between the scents.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Like several other tedious and complicated traditions, this one has become simplified over time.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: But this is the only Rite of Parting to take place for one of The Seven in three thousand seven hundred years. As such, I do think we should honor tradition down to the last detail in this case.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Now that's settled, a question... Ahem. Do you have any Mora on you?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You forgot to bring money again!? Grr, Zhongli!!!

choices.text: I see a pattern emerging here.

response.speaker: Bolai
response.text: If I may interject... Did I hear you say that these flowers are to be an offering to the Lord of Geo himself?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yes... in a sense.

response.speaker: Bolai
response.text: Gosh. Well, why didn't you say so? I heard the awful news about what happened at this year's Rite of Descension...

response.speaker: Bolai
response.text: It would be bad luck to say it out loud. But I've been worried about our dear Lord ever since... I'm worried that everything I've heard is true...

response.speaker: Bolai
response.text: Since these flowers will be used to glorify our Lord, they're free of charge. Just don't forget to pass on my regards.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Are you serious?

response.speaker: Bolai
response.text: Why wouldn't I be? I would be nobody if not for Rex Lapis!

response.speaker: Bolai
response.text: If he hadn't written those poems in praise of my wares, they'd only be worth a fraction of what I can sell them for today...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh... So much folklore here revolves around Liyue's deity making cameo appearances in support of local businesses...

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: ...Thank you, boss. I think I speak for all of us when I say that your generosity has saved our skins.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: "Our" skins? You were the one who forgot to bring money!

response.speaker: Bolai
response.text: Please. It's the least I could do.

choices.text: By this point, I'd be more surprised if he'd remembered.
I'm still an ignoramus on horticulture...
This is what I get for calling Paimon "emergency food."
Wait... You don't even recognize me!?

response.speaker: Bolai
response.text: I'm sorry? Ah, yes... We've met before, haven't we? Sorry, Traveler. I shouldn't have spoken to you in that tone.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So now that we've got the flowers, how do we make the perfume?

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Ideally, with the help of an expert. Unfortunately, none of my acquaintances have personal experience in the art of decoction...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Talk about first-world problems...

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Hence, I need you to help by asking around in the city. Try the common folk, especially women.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So this time we get to go around town looking for nice-smelling ladies to talk to? Paimon likes this job!

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: I will wait for you near the Statue of The Seven. Meet me there when the perfume is ready.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Lan! We need to ask you for a favor...

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: I stopped accepting commissions a long time ago. Sorry, you two, but you'll just have to ask another adventurer.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, it's not that kind of favor. It's just a teeny-tiny thing...

choices.text: Do you know how to make perfume?

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: ...Wow. Just wow.

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: Do I look like the kind of girl who wears perfume to you? I think you're underestimating the kind of person I am...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, Paimon thinks you smell amazing! So come on Lan, what's your secret? If not perfume?

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: Now that you mention it... Yes, there is something. What is that scent?

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: Oh, it must be from the Qingxin flowers I picked on the way back. I forgot I still had them with me...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Aha! The truth is out, Lan's got a soft spot for wildflowers!

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: Ahh... No, they were for medicinal use only.

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: Anyway, this is a pointless conversation. If you want to know about perfume, try talking to <color=#00E1FFFF>Qiming</color>.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The fortune-teller, right? Paimon remembers she smells pretty good!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Thanks, Lan! See you around~

choices.text: You smell great.

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: ...Wow. Just wow.

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: I am just going to assume that you are either joking or being sarcastic.

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: To be fair, I put a lot of effort into my appearance for someone who spends all their time in the great outdoors. But "I smell great"? Don't be ridiculous.

dialogues.speaker: Qiming
dialogues.text: Hello. How may I help?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We've come to ask you a question...

choices.text: Do you know how to make perfume?

response.speaker: Qiming
response.text: Perfume? I rarely think to use it, let alone about how to make it myself.

response.speaker: Qiming
response.text: That said, some of the cosmetics I use are scented. Perhaps that's the cause of this confusion.

response.speaker: Qiming
response.text: Since I usually set up my stall by the docks, I avoid perfume like the plague. Because Celestia forbid those lusty sailors catch a whiff and come hunting for the source!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's the worst thing Paimon's heard all day.

response.speaker: Qiming
response.text: While we're on the subject, have you never heard anyone mention Ying'er's homemade perfume?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ying'er... Oh, as in <color=#00E1FFFF>Scent of Spring</color> Ying'er?

response.speaker: Qiming
response.text: Yes, that's her. Many a rich family's daughter has gotten her to make perfume for them. Apparently, her homemade product is better than anything you'll find on the market.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Great, this is just the intel we need! Finally, we're getting somewhere.

choices.text: You smell great.

response.speaker: Qiming
response.text: ...Sorry, you caught me off guard. Most people aren't so direct.

response.speaker: Qiming
response.text: I think we need more time to get to know each other...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh... We just wanted to know what perfume you normally use.

response.speaker: Qiming
response.text: Oh... Ahem. Well. I don't actually use any.

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: Well hello... You found me at last. I've been waiting for you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What? How did you know we were coming?

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: Oh, I heard a rumor about a couple who were snooping around town looking for a sweet-smelling lady...

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: Actually, I was starting to worry you wouldn't find me. This is the ultimate test of my appeal, after all...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "Snooping around"? Why are you making it out like we're bad people?

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: What can I say? People love to talk... Maybe you ought to be more discreet in the future if you don't want word to get around.

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: Relax... I know why you're here. You want to get your hand on my homemade perfume, don't you? What kind would you like?

choices.text: A bespoke triple-Silk-Flower variety...

response.speaker: Ying'er
response.text: Three in one go... My goodness.

response.speaker: Ying'er
response.text: You have extreme tastes for someone your age. Maybe the rumors I heard were true after all. You're on the prowl and need some sweet-smelling ammunition, is that it?

choices.text: It's for Rex Lapis.

response.speaker: Ying'er
response.text: Tsk... Is that the best you could come up with? Even if you were genuinely offering perfume to a deity, that doesn't explain why you'd need three kinds. Sorry, your story just doesn't hold water!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Zhongli was right... People don't remember this tradition anymore.

response.speaker: Ying'er
response.text: As one of my favorite poems goes, "Oh, cherry tree, begrudge not thy blossoms as they are deflowered in the spring, for come winter, even thy sturdiest wood shall wither."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That went over Paimon's head a little...

response.speaker: Ying'er
response.text: In short, I'm happy to help. Traveler, you can be my assistant. But you'd better make sure I'm the only person on your mind while you're hanging around with me...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Okay...

response.speaker: Ying'er
response.text: So... Where is a good place for making sweet, sweet perfume?

choices.text: Dadaupa Gorge!

response.speaker: Ying'er
response.text: Where is that? Mondstadt? We're only making some perfume, there's no need to go to such ridiculous lengths.

response.speaker: Ying'er
response.text: Somewhere closer to home will do. Let's go for the kitchen at the <color=#00E1FFFF>Wanmin Restaurant</color>.

choices.text: How about the kitchen at Xiangling's place...

response.speaker: Ying'er
response.text: You mean <color=#00E1FFFF>Wanmin Restaurant</color>? Good choice! Let's go.

choices.text: You got a problem with that?

response.speaker: Ying'er
response.text: Ay yai yai, who let this tiger out of the cage!? Well, with your looks, who can blame you? If you've got it, flaunt it.

choices.text: Whichever one you're wearing.

response.speaker: Ying'er
response.text: Heh... I'm not wearing any, darling.

response.speaker: Ying'er
response.text: Could it be that you've been bewitched by my natural scent? If so, I'm afraid it's one of a kind...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Whatever this is, you guys need to snap out of it right now! {NICKNAME}, Hand her the Silk Flowers!

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: I've had a word with Chef Mao. We can start work now.

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: Are you ready to please me?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...What did you say?

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: I meant make me proud. As my assistant. Obviously.

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: While I'm setting up, you can go and fetch some water.

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: This water will do nicely.

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: Now, I need you to extract the Silk Flower essence using a crafting bench.

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: Perfume-making uses an altogether different technique from alchemy. Here, let me teach you. Very carefully, take hold of the mortar and pestle... Gently does it...

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: You need to keep your wrist firm so your hand doesn't slip...

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: Now, use your strong hand to stir it with a persistent rhythm... Keep going until the juices start to come out...

choices.text: Don't worry, I know what I'm doing.

response.speaker: Ying'er
response.text: Ooh... You're a natural! Like a fish to water.

response.speaker: Ying'er
response.text: Now, take these and try it out on your own using a nearby <color=#00E1FFFF>crafting bench</color>.

response.speaker: Ying'er
response.text: Don't forget to do all three. They look visually identical during the essence extraction process, but I will put them into separate containers when the perfume is ready.

choices.text: Okay, okay, I get it...

talks.objective: Grind the Silk Flowers to extract the essence

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Maybe we can find some good candidates at the Adventurers' Guild?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We've brought the perfumes, Mr. Zhongli!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Did we take too long? You were just staring up at the statue...

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Oh, you're back. Don't worry, I haven't waited long.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Compared to the watch that Rex Lapis' statues have kept over Liyue, this was but a brief moment.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Haha, well, how can a person compete with a statue?

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: That is true. Well, have you brought the perfumes?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Three sets and not one less!

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Thank you both. Let us offer them up.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Offer Golden House Maiden

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This is the first kind of perfume. Ms. Ying'er said that it's sweet as a dream, and it's liked by younger ladies.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Offer Valley Weaver

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This is the second kind. It's got an elegant smell, and the daughters of high society love it!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Offer Fate's Yearning

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The third kind has a gentle but lingering fragrance, something something like the dusk mist, and it's a favorite of mature ladies.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh... what was that?

choices.text: Looks like Rex Lapis really likes this one.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's the one older ladies like, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Does that mean that Rex Lapis is actually an older lady?

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Haha, perhaps, perhaps.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Rex Lapis has taken on countless forms. Perhaps that really was one of them.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What a shame, we only got to see the giant dragon form, and...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let's hope the Qixing can catch the real killer.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: We can leave that to the authorities. Let us focus on the fond farewell for Rex Lapis.

choices.text: (What ulterior motives do Childe and the Qixing have...)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So, we've finished another step in our preparations. What's next?

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Next, I would like the two of you to help me borrow the Cleansing Bell.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Cleansing Bell?

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: At present, a friend of mine named Madame Ping is the guardian of the Cleansing Bell. She lives near Yujing Terrace. If you ask her, she will know what to do.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sure, but... aren't you going to come with us?

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Ah, I have certain reasons why I cannot be there in person. Please do this for me.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Man, why's he got to be so secretive this time?

choices.text: (Well, we do need to see the Exuvia...)
I guess the final answer is number three.

talks.objective: Give the Silk Flower Essence to Ying'er

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: Wow, this is some exquisite Silk Flower Essence. On to the next stage, the most important one of all...

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: The essence is placed into water and simmered over low heat until most of the water has boiled off.

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: You must take care to control the heat during this process. If the temperature goes too high, it will affect the scent.

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: So please, focus on controlling the heat. This is the final step.

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: Don't waste a drop of that essence, now. We want all of it in there.

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: All three perfumes are ready. And you, my friend, were a wonderful assistant.

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: A testament to the lengths you will go to for romance... It's so rare to see nowadays.

choices.text: I told you, it's not like that...

response.speaker: Ying'er
response.text: Anyway... Shall I give you a brief overview of each scent? It might just help you match the right scent to the right occasion...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon wants to hear this!

response.speaker: Ying'er
response.text: This first one is sweet as candy, straight out of a fairy tale... Younger women will love it.

response.speaker: Ying'er
response.text: The second one is for those with more refined tastes... The first choice for daughters of high society.

response.speaker: Ying'er
response.text: Finally, the third one has a soft but lingering scent, like a mist that captures the last light of dusk. Mature women adore this one.

response.speaker: Ying'er
response.text: All clear? Don't get them mixed up now, you'll ruin the mood...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I... I think I got it...

response.speaker: Ying'er
response.text: Good. Be sure to come visit if you ever need help with anything, okay?

response.speaker: Ying'er
response.text: I'll leave you with some parting words:

response.speaker: Ying'er
response.text: One who tries to sail three boats simultaneously should be careful not to go overboard.

response.speaker: Ying'er
response.text: Heh. Come and hang out with me at Scent of Spring sometime, okay?

choices.text: I was thinking of you the whole time.

response.speaker: Ying'er
response.text: Wow, you actually remembered my throwaway comment...

response.speaker: Ying'er
response.text: Y'know, you're cuter than people give you credit for. If I didn't have my guard up, I can see how easily one could be taken in...

talks.objective: Offer the perfumes to the Statue of The Seven

dialogues.speaker: Bolai
dialogues.text: May the rumors be false, and Rex Lapis be well...

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: Oh? Not going to look for Qiming yet?

dialogues.speaker: Qiming
dialogues.text: If you have the time, come and have your fortune told down by the harbor. I'll give you a special price.

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: Well, aren't you going to try it out? Has the crafting bench broken?

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: Or would you prefer some... hands-on guidance for your first time...?

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: Have you fetched the water? ...No?

dialogues.speaker: Ying'er
dialogues.text: Have a look <color=#00E1FFFF>behind Wanmin Restaurant</color>. Chef Mao is a professional chef, he must keep a store of pure water.
